ai_result.long_description:
Keep your everyday essentials organized with this handmade brown leather belt pouch. Designed as a compact EDC carry-all, it can hold coins, bank cards, keys, banknotes and other small items in one convenient accessory.

The pouch is made from high-quality Italian leather and completely hand-stitched with waxed thread. Its compact dimensions measure 3.54 inches high × 5.12 inches wide × 1.37 inches deep (90 mm × 130 mm × 35 mm), while the belt-compatible design fits standard belts up to 1.57 inches wide (up to 40 mm).

It can hold approximately a dozen bank cards along with a certain amount of banknotes, making it useful for everyday errands, travel and hands-free carry. This handmade leather pouch also makes a practical gift for a father, brother or friend.
